sentences.text: On the Garnet-Retail test split, Thimble achieves a long-tail Recall@20 of 0.091, compared with 0.085 for Cobble-GNN with debiased sampling and 0.072 for Cobble-GNN with uniform sampling.

Adding popularity-debiased negative sampling to Cobble-GNN improves long-tail Recall@20 from 0.072 to 0.085, a relative gain of about 18%, consistent with the roughly 20% relative gains attributed to such sampling in prior work (Sorensen-Nakata et al., 2022).

Thimble's overall Recall@20 (0.219) is slightly higher than Cobble-GNN's (0.214) and Cobble-GNN with debiased sampling (0.212), but no statistical tests were reported, so these differences may not be significant.
